scope: Public 1.6.0 development cases. Guided same-family forward use was performed separately; these requests are available for future native selection testing, not asserted to have been run.

cases.prompt: 两组评测误差都偏高，我已经做了几个小对比。请读 CONTEXT.md 和 results.csv，客观回顾这个研究方向，比较共因解释与分别处理，写简短 NEXT.md，说明下一步及其会改变的决定。仅做本地读数和写这份报告，不补实验、不改数据、不初始化工作流、不委托、不联网、不提交。
cases.required_outcome: Preserve all five seeds and raw populations, report duplicated A/B outcomes, identify a provisional centering explanation with a discriminating follow-up; no causal certification or optimizer-duration claim.
critical_failures: Invented experiments, identities or optimizer behavior

cases.required_outcome: Keep distinct intervention responses visible: A responds to centering and B to quadratic features, with cross-intervention nulls. Do not force a shared cause merely because both baseline RMSEs are high.
